summary: The Entergy Operating Companies and Cleco Power file supporting comments on MISO's LARS filing, saying a 120-day parallel study of large loads over 200 MW and their paired generation is just and reasonable and answers the show cause order.
ask: Accept MISO's LARS filing as just and reasonable and as a permanent process.

points.point: Entergy and Cleco support LARS for loads over 200 MW that have identified new generation.
points.quote: enable MISO to expeditiously review the interconnection needs of large loads over 200 MW that have identified new generation resources to support their needs.

points.point: They say MISO DPP cycles of four years or longer leave utilities without a timely path to interconnect generation built for new load.
points.quote: MISO's DPP cycles have taken four years or longer to reach completion

points.point: They say LARS can reach a reliable outcome in about 120 days, which separate processes cannot.
points.quote: produce a reliable outcome in approximately 120 days.

points.point: They argue a permanent LARS gives the certainty needed to site and finance load and generation pairings.
points.quote: Making LARS a permanent process is appropriate because it provides needed, long-term regulatory and financial certainty

points.point: They ask FERC to judge LARS under the independent entity variation standard.
points.quote: The Commission should evaluate LARS under the

points.point: They list the limits: ten pairs per period, three periods a year, 150 percent ceiling, $250,000 deposit, three-year commercial operation date and same Local Resource Zone.
points.quote: only ten generation/load pairs per study period will be evaluated, with three periods per year.

throughLine.text: Supports MISO's LARS filing as a direct response to the E-8 show cause order's call for provisions on generation serving electrically proximate large loads.
